title: prunus persica var. compressa
intro: Prunus persica var. compressa, commonly known as dwarf peach, is a compact and dwarf variety of peach tree. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include aiding in digestion, lowering cholesterol levels, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Prunus persica var. compressa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
